inferences.nonzero_current_time_reversal: nonzero j forbids separate T invariance of the intrinsic state
inferences.AMR_cancellation: opposite circulation gives zero integrated transverse moment by symmetry, not pointwise zero local current or all M1 matrix elements
inferences.beta_boundary: no universal beta2=0.20 MR/AMR-to-ER boundary follows from these equations
inferences.gamma_boundary: nonzero gamma alone is insufficient; require Jm>Js,Jl, both gyroscopes, and omega>omega_c
inferences.quantum_observables: S(I), B(M1)/B(E2), and partner splitting require band-resolved quantum spectra and transition operators; absent here
